questions.question:
[지문]
This is Mr. Kim's English class. His students introduce their favorite things in mystery bags.

Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it? Ta-da! It's a beetle. Its name is Beeti. Are you afraid of it? Look! It's so cute.

Hello, everyone. My name is Jiho. I'm a great dancer. I always carry this item. It's not big, but it makes a big sound. What is it? Yes, it's my Bluetooth speaker. With this speaker, every place is my stage. I often dance for my grandmother. She is my big fan.

Hello, I'm Mina. My favorite sport is baseball. I'm a catcher, so this item is very important for me. Thanks to this, my hand is safe. What is it? That's right! It's my glove. I play baseball with my friends every day. Come and join us!

위 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

In Mr. Kim's class, students are (A)_______ their favorite items, which show their personal (B)_______.
questions.explanation: 학생들이 자신의 좋아하는 물건을 소개하고 있으므로 'sharing'이 적절하며, 이러한 물건들은 개인의 관심사를 보여주므로 'interests'가 정답입니다.

options: ① The weather is nice. It's warm and sunny.
② Do you have a boy friend?
③ I like your bag. It's pretty.
④ I like music. Do you like music, too?
⑤ Do you have any plan for this weekend?
questions.question:
원어민 선생님과의 일상적인 대화(small talk)에 부적절한 표현을 고르시오.

① The weather is nice. It's warm and sunny.
② Do you have a boy friend?
③ I like your bag. It's pretty.
④ I like music. Do you like music, too?
⑤ Do you have any plan for this weekend?
questions.explanation: Small talk에서는 개인적인 질문을 피해야 합니다. 상대방의 연애 관계에 대해 직접 묻는 것은 부적절합니다.

questions.question:
[대화]
A: Hi, I'm Taeho. Nice to meet you.
B: Hi, I'm Somin. ________________, too.
A: What's that in your bag?
B: It's my tennis racket.
A: Do you like tennis?
B: Yes, I do. Do you like tennis, too?
A: No, I don't. I like basketball.

위 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'Nice to see you'는 처음 만날 때 사용하는 표현이 아니라 이미 알고 있는 사람을 다시 만났을 때 사용하는 표현이므로 부적절합니다. 첫 인사에서는 'meet'을 사용해야 합니다.

options: 하영: 태호는 지금 농구를 하고 있어.
서영: 태호와 소민이는 모두 테니스를 좋아해.
민주: 태호의 가방 속에는 테니스 라켓이 있어.
영서: 두 사람은 아주 친한 친구 사이야.
questions.question:
[대화]
A: Hi, I'm Taeho. Nice to meet you.
B: Hi, I'm Somin. ________________, too.
A: What's that in your bag?
B: It's my tennis racket.
A: Do you like tennis?
B: Yes, I do. Do you like tennis, too?
A: No, I don't. I like basketball.

대화의 내용을 바르게 이해한 사람은?
questions.explanation: 대화에서 Somin이 'Yes, I do. Do you like tennis, too?'라고 했으므로 소민이는 테니스를 좋아합니다. 태호는 'No, I don't. I like basketball.'이라고 했으므로 태호는 테니스를 좋아하지 않습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Mystery Bag
This is Mr. Kim's English class. His students (A) _________ their favorite things in mystery bags.

Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it?

Ta-da! It's a beetle. (B) _________ name is Beeti. Are you afraid of it? Look! It's so cute.

다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 적절하게 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 3인칭 단수 주어 'His students'에 동사 'introduces'가 와야 합니다. (B)는 소유격 'Its'가 맞습니다. ('Its name is Beeti')

options: No, I don't. I like pizza.
Yes, I do. I love spaghetti.
Yes, I like cheese spaghetti a lot.
questions.question:
[대화]
A: Lucas, look. Today's menu is spaghetti.
B: Do you like spaghetti, Judy?
A: ____________________________________

다음 대화에서 B가 묻는 질문에 대해 A가 답한 것 중 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 'Do you like spaghetti?'라는 yes/no 질문에 'No, I like tomato spaghetti.'는 문법적으로 모순입니다. 'No'라고 시작했으면 다른 음식을 좋아한다고 해야 하는데, 'tomato spaghetti'는 스파게티의 종류이므로 부적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Hello, everyone. My name is Jiho. I'm a great dancer.

(A) Yes, it's my Bluetooth speaker. With this speaker, every place is my stage.
(B) I always carry this item. It's not big, but it makes a big sound. What is it?
(C) I often dance for my grandmother. She is my big fan.

글의 흐름이 자연스럽도록 (A)~(C)를 배열한 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 자연스러운 흐름은 (B) 물건이 무엇인가를 묻고 → (A) 답변하고 → (C) 그것으로 무엇을 하는지 설명하는 순서가 맞습니다.

options: doing your homework in your room
questions.question:
[대화]
A: Are you ________________?
B: Yes, I am.

다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'Are you have a brother?'는 문법적으로 잘못된 표현입니다. 'Do you have a brother?'로 물어야 합니다. 'Are'는 be동사이므로 'have'와 함께 사용할 수 없습니다.

options: 그는 실제 물리적인 무대 위에서만 춤을 춘다.
그는 학교 연극 공연을 위해 연습하고 있다.
그의 할머니는 그를 응원하기 위해 어디든 따라다닌다.
그는 자신감 있게 춤을 추기 위해 소리가 큰 스피커가 필요하다.
그는 어떤 장소에서든 열정적으로 춤출 준비와 의지가 되어 있다.
questions.question:
[지문]
Hello, everyone. My name is Jiho. I'm a great dancer. I always carry this item. It's not big, but it makes a big sound. What is it? Yes, it's my Bluetooth speaker. With this speaker, every place is my stage. I often dance for my grandmother. She is my big fan.

밑줄 친 "every place is my stage"가 글의 흐름상 함축하는 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'every place is my stage'는 어떤 장소든 무대가 될 수 있다는 의미로, 어디서나 춤을 출 수 있다는 열정과 자신감을 나타냅니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it? Ta-da! It's a beetle. Its name is Beeti. Are you afraid of it? Look! It's so cute.

다음 글을 읽고 Kate에 대해 알 수 있는 내용을 <보기>에서 모두 고른 것은?

<보기>
a. Her favorite thing is small.
b. Her brother also loves the beetle.
c. Her beetle can sometimes fly.
d. She thinks her beetle is cute.
e. She is afraid of her beetle.
questions.explanation: a. 'It's small' - 참 | b. 'my brother doesn't like it' - 거짓 | c. 'it sometimes flies' - 참 | d. 'It's so cute' - 참 | e. 'Are you afraid of it?'는 다른 사람에게 묻는 질문이지 Kate가 afraid하다는 뜻은 아닙니다 - 거짓

questions.question:
[지문]
Hello, everyone. I'm Sara. Nice to meet you. I am a school librarian. My school library has a lot of different books. I like picture books. How about you? Come here and read some interesting books.

다음은 윗글의 내용을 표로 정리한 것이다. 각 문장이 맞으면 (T), 틀리면 (F)로 표시했을 때, (T)/(F)의 연결이 잘못된 것은?
ⓐ Sara is a school librarian. (T)
ⓑ Sara works at a bookstore. (F)
ⓒ Sara likes picture books. (T)
ⓓ Sara doesn't like reading. (F)
ⓔ Sara's school library has many kinds of books. (F)
questions.explanation: ⓔ 'Sara's school library has many kinds of books.'는 지문의 'My school library has a lot of different books'에서 참이므로 (T)여야 합니다. 문제에서는 (F)로 표시되어 있으므로 잘못된 것입니다.

options: In Mr. Kim's class, students introduce their favorite things.
Kate introduces her best friend at school to other friends.
Jiho likes to dance with his speaker.
Mina thinks her glove is very precious.
Everything in mystery bags is moving.
questions.question:
[지문]
Mystery Bag
This is Mr. Kim's English class. His students introduce their favorite things in mystery bags.

Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it?

Ta-da! It's a beetle. Its name is Beeti. Are you afraid of it? Look! It's so cute.

Hello, everyone. My name is Jiho. I'm a great dancer. I always carry this item. It's not big, but it makes a big sound. What is it?

Yes, it's my Bluetooth speaker. With this speaker, every place is my stage. I often dance for my grandmother. She is my big fan.

Hello, I'm Mina. My favorite sport is baseball. I'm a catcher, so this item is very important for me. Thanks to this, my hand is safe. What is it?

That's right! It's my glove. I play baseball with my friends every day. Come and join us!

다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것 2개를 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ② Kate는 beetle(곤충)을 소개하고 있으며, 이것이 학교의 친구가 아닙니다. ⑤ 모든 물건이 움직이는 것은 아닙니다. Kate의 beetle이 '때때로' 날 수 있고, Jiho의 스피커와 Mina의 글러브는 움직이지 않습니다.

questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고, 위 대화의 주어진 문장에 이어질 내용을 바르게 배열한 것은?

Taeho: Hi, I'm Taeho. Nice to meet you.
(A) What's that in your bag?
(B) Hi, I'm Somin. Nice to meet you, too.
(C) It's my tennis racket.
Taeho: Do you like tennis?
Somin: __(가)__. Do you like tennis, too?
Taeho: __(나)__. I like basketball.
questions.explanation: 자연스러운 대화의 흐름은 인사(B) → 가방 안의 물건에 대해 묻기(A) → 답변하기(C)의 순서가 맞습니다.

questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고, 위 대화의 밑줄 친 (가)와 (나)에 들어갈 응답을 <보기>에서 적절히 짝지은 것은?

Taeho: Hi, I'm Taeho. Nice to meet you.
(A) What's that in your bag?
(B) Hi, I'm Somin. Nice to meet you, too.
(C) It's my tennis racket.
Taeho: Do you like tennis?
Somin: __(가)__. Do you like tennis, too?
Taeho: __(나)__. I like basketball.

<보기>
(a) Yes, I am. (b) Yes, you do.
(c) Yes, I do. (d) No, I'm not.
(e) No, you don't. (f) No, I don't.
questions.explanation: (가) 'Do you like tennis?'에 대한 긍정 답변은 'Yes, I do.'(c)이고, (나) 'Do you like tennis, too?'에 대한 부정 답변은 'No, I don't.'(f)입니다.

options: 학생들은 자신이 가장 좋아하는 것을 소개하고 있다.
questions.question:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 고르시오.

This is Mr. Kim's English class. His students introduce their favorite things in mystery bags.

Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My big friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it?

Ta-da! It's a beetle. Its name is Beeti. Are you afraid of it? Look! It's so cute.

Hello, I'm Mina. My favorite sport is baseball. I'm a catcher, so this item is very important for me. (A)이것 덕분에, my hand is safe. What is it?

That's right! It's my glove. I play baseball with my friends every day. Come and join us!
questions.explanation: Mina는 포수(catcher)이고 글루브(glove)가 중요하다고 했지, 헬멧을 중요하게 여긴다고 하지 않았습니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 문맥상 적절하지 않은 단어는?

This is Mr. Kim's English class. His students introduce their ⓐfavorite things in mystery bags.

Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My ⓑbig friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it?

Ta-da! It's a beetle. Its name is Beeti. Are you afraid of it? Look! It's so ⓒcute.

Hello, I'm Mina. My favorite sport is baseball. I'm a catcher, so this item is very ⓓimportant for me. (A)이것 덕분에, my hand is ⓔsafe. What is it?

That's right! It's my glove. I play baseball with my friends every day. Come and join us!
questions.explanation: 딱정벌레는 작은 동물이므로 'big friend'라는 표현은 모순됩니다. 'little friend' 또는 'small friend'가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my ①mystery bag. What's in the bag? My ②little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes ③flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it? Ta-da! It's a beetle. Its name is Beeti. Are you ④afraid of it? Look! It's so ⑤scary.
questions.explanation: 글의 문맥에서 'It's so cute'라고 표현했으므로, 마지막의 'scary'는 적절하지 않습니다. 'cute'가 맞는 표현입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 문맥상 어색한 것은?

Hello, everyone. My name is Sara. ⓐGlad to meet you. I am a school ⓑlibrarian. My school library has a lot of ⓒdifferent books. I ⓓlove picture books. How about you? Come here and read some ⓔboring books.
questions.explanation: 도서관 사서가 학생들에게 책을 읽으라고 권하면서 'boring books'(지루한 책)이라고 표현하는 것은 어색합니다. 'interesting books'(흥미로운 책)이 적절합니다.

options: 학생들이 얼마나 값비싼 물건을 가졌는지 자랑하기 위해
물건을 보지 않고 손의 감각만으로 맞히게 하기 위해
학생들의 호기심을 유발하여 발표에 흥미를 갖게 하기 위해
학생들이 가방을 얼마나 창의적으로 꾸미는지 평가하기 위해
자신의 물건을 다른 사람들에게 들키지 않도록 숨기기 위해
questions.question:
다음 글을 통해 '미스터리 백(mystery bags)' 활동의 목적에 관해 추론할 수 있는 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?

This is Mr. Kim's English class. His students introduce their favorite things in mystery bags.
questions.explanation: mystery bags의 개념상 물건을 처음에는 보이지 않게 하여 호기심을 유발하고, 학생들이 자신의 물건에 대해 설명하며 발표하게 함으로써 흥미를 갖게 하는 것이 목적입니다.

questions.question:
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

[주어진 문장] She is my big fan.

Hello, everyone. My name is Jiho. I'm a great dancer. ( ① ) I always carry this item. ( ② ) It's not big, but it makes a big sound. ( ③ ) What is it? Yes, it's my Bluetooth speaker. ( ④ ) With this speaker, every place is my stage. I often dance for my grandmother. ( ⑤ )
questions.explanation: 'I often dance for my grandmother'라는 문장 뒤에 'She is my big fan.'이 오면 자연스럽게 할머니가 자신의 열렬한 팬임을 설명하는 흐름이 됩니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 문장에 'always'를 넣어 문장을 완성할 때, 가장 적절한 위치는?

[문장] I carry this item.

ⓐ I ⓑ carry ⓒ this ⓓ item. ⓔ
questions.explanation: 부사 'always'는 동사 앞에 오는 것이 일반적이므로 'I always carry this item'이 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글에서 빈칸 (A)~(C)에 가장 적절한 단어의 조합은?

Hello, everyone. I'm Jiho. I'm a great __(A)__. I carry this item. It's not big, but it makes a big sound. What is it? Yes, it's my Bluetooth speaker. With this speaker, every __(B)__ is my stage. I __(C)__ for my grandmother. She is my big fan.
questions.explanation:
(A) 'I'm a great dancer' - 직업을 나타내므로 'dancer'(명사)
(B) 'every place is my stage' - 단수형 'place'가 맞음
(C) 'I dance for my grandmother' - 동사 'dance'가 맞음

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Hi, I'm Kate. Look at my mystery bag. What's in the bag? My little friend is in this bag. It's small, and it sometimes flies. I love it a lot, but my brother doesn't like it. What is it? Ta-da! It's a beetle. Its name is Beeti. Are you _________ of it? Look! It's so cute.
questions.explanation: 'Are you afraid of it?'는 '그것이 두렵니?'라는 의미로 일반적인 질문 패턴이며, 다음 문장 'Look! It's so cute'에 자연스럽게 연결됩니다.

questions.question:
자연스러운 대화가 되도록 (A)~(E)를 바르게 배열한 것은?

Taeho: Hi. I'm Taeho. Nice to meet you.
(A) Do you like tennis?
(B) It's my tennis racket.
(C) What's that in your bag?
(D) Yes, I do. Do you like tennis, too?
(E) Hi, I'm Somin. Nice to meet you, too.
Taeho: No, I don't. I like basketball.
questions.explanation: 자연스러운 흐름: 인사(E) → 물건 묻기(C) → 대답(B) → 스포츠 좋아하는지 묻기(A) → 긍정 답변 및 역질문(D)

questions.question:
다음 글에서 Sara가 가장 좋아하는 책의 종류는 무엇인가?

Hello, everyone. My name is Sara. Nice to meet you. I am a school librarian. My school library has a lot of different books. I love picture books. How about you? Come here and read some interesting books.
questions.explanation: 글에서 'I love picture books'라고 명시되어 있으므로, Sara가 가장 좋아하는 책은 Picture books입니다.
